bio: Creator of @TraceLoom (4.2k ⭐ on GitHub). Deterministic replay, fault injection & regression evals for production MCP & multi-agent systems.
discovered_via: SEG-03: SEA Vertical AI & Agent Founders

recent_posts.text: Shipped TraceLoom v0.9: you can now record a failed 15-step production agent trajectory, mock the exact external API state at step 9, and run 500 parallel prompt/model diffs in CI in under 40 seconds.
Most agent eval tools just run an LLM-as-a-judge on final text output. In production, 80% of failures happen in malformed tool arguments, retry storms, and stale context windows.
